description.value: Sundays Coffee Bar + Provisions is a community-oriented café on Somenos Road in Duncan, BC, formerly operating as the Guild Coffee & Lifestyle Boutique. The owner describes it as a gathering space built around excellent coffee and shared connection — a deliberate 'Sunday kind of vibe' rather than a transactional stop. The café also sells provisions, giving touring cyclists a potential combined opportunity to refuel and resupply.
